# Aevon: full version

> Full-content companion to llms.txt. The complete text of the Aevon home page,
> the Cadre page and the Aevon Health page, for LLM crawlers that want the whole
> story without fetching each page. Last updated 22 November 2026.

## Aevon

Aevon is a Canadian software company. It builds operational software for businesses
that have outgrown a spreadsheet but are too specific for the large platforms.
Its product is Cadre: HR and certification tracking software for trades, transport
and manufacturing employers. It also offers Aevon Health, administrative automation
for medical clinics in British Columbia and Ontario that connects to the clinic's
EMR through its official API. Founded 2026.

## Cadre

HR and certification tracking software for trades, transport and manufacturing.
Cadre keeps every certification on the employee record, next to onboarding,
performance reviews and signed policies, so the renewal is already on the calendar
when the course is done. It notifies the employee and then their supervisor by
email and Microsoft Teams before a certificate expires. Pricing is one flat monthly
fee per site with unlimited employees and every module included, month to month,
quoted by email. Live demo, no signup: https://cadre-demo.web.app/dashboard

### Cadre questions, answered in full

**What is Cadre?**

Cadre is HR and certification tracking software for trades, transport and manufacturing employers, made by Aevon in Canada. Every certification sits on the employee record, next to that person's onboarding, performance reviews and signed policies.

**What does Cadre track for each certification?**

An issue date, a renewal period and an expiry date, per person and per ticket, such as forklift, first aid, fall protection or a driver abstract. The training record and the certification are the same record, so completing the course closes the renewal.

**How does Cadre warn about expiring certificates?**

It notifies the employee and then their supervisor by email and Microsoft Teams before the expiry date, so there is still time to book the course.

**What else is included besides certification tracking?**

Onboarding, performance reviews, policy sign-off and the org chart are part of the same system, not a separate HR add-on.

**How is Cadre priced?**

One flat monthly fee per site, with unlimited employees at that site and every module included. It is month to month. A quote needs only headcount, number of sites and which tickets you track, and is sent by email without a discovery call.

**Can we move from a spreadsheet?**

Yes. Cadre imports from whatever you keep now, the spreadsheet included, and setup is done with you.

**Can I see Cadre before talking to anyone?**

Yes. The live demo at cadre-demo.web.app is the real product with a sample company loaded. No signup is needed.

**Can Cadre show an auditor who is current?**

Yes. You can export who is current as a CSV, filtered by site, by ticket or by status.

## Aevon Health

Assign the follow-up. It gets booked. Aevon Health is administrative
automation for medical clinics in BC and Ontario that connects to the clinic's EMR
through its official API (OSCAR, with Accuro and TELUS CHR on request). A doctor
assigns a follow-up task to Aevon in place of the front desk. Aevon reads the
doctor's own wording, such as RTC 6/52 or f/u 2 wks, and texts the patient three
open times from the doctor's schedule, never on a holiday or a day the clinic is
closed. The patient picks one, or asks for other times, such as mornings only. The
visit is booked in the EMR, the patient gets a confirmation and the task is closed
with a note. If the patient does not reply, they get two reminders and then the task
returns to the front desk. A task marked urgent, a patient with no consent on file,
and any message about results, symptoms or medication go to the front desk. It uses
text and email only and does not make voice calls. It never decides anything
clinical and never books anything urgent.

It also books new referrals: it acknowledges the referring office, asks for what is
missing, offers times by text to patients who have agreed to texts and books the one
they pick. And it fills cancelled appointments from the clinic's own waitlist.
Clinics start with 30 days at no charge, with free onboarding.

### Aevon Health questions, answered in full

**How does a doctor assign a follow-up?**

In the EMR, the doctor creates a task as usual and assigns it to Aevon in place of the front desk. For example: Follow-up in 6 weeks, 15 min. Nothing else changes for the doctor.

**What does the patient see?**

A text from your clinic. It says it is from an automated assistant, names the doctor and offers three open times. The patient replies 1, 2 or 3, or asks for other times, and gets a confirmation. The messages contain no health details.

**What happens when a patient does not reply?**

They get two reminders. After that the task goes back to your front desk with a note.

**Does it call patients?**

No. It uses text and email only. It does not make voice calls.

**Which patients does it contact?**

Only patients who have agreed to texts or email with your clinic. If there is no consent on file, the task goes to your front desk.

**Does it decide anything clinical?**

No. It never decides anything clinical and never books anything urgent. A task marked urgent goes to your front desk without a text to the patient. If a patient writes about results, symptoms or medication, the task goes to your front desk with their words quoted.

**Does this replace our EMR or booking tool?**

No. It works alongside your EMR and does not replace it. If you use an online booking tool, that keeps working the way it does now.

**How does a new referral get booked?**

If the patient has agreed to texts with your clinic, they are offered times your clinic allows, by text. If there is no consent to text on file, your staff get a task to make the first call instead. When a patient picks a time, a referral that meets all your clinic's rules is booked and the confirmation and welcome email go out. If anything is missing or unusual, it goes to your staff.

**What does it cost?**

Pricing is per physician per month, plus a one-time setup fee. Clinics start with 30 days at no charge, with free onboarding.

**What if we want to stop?**

Your clinic disables the one EMR account we use, and our access ends.

## Pages

- [Cadre](https://aevon.ca/cadre.html): what Cadre does, pricing model, and questions answered
- [Training matrix template](https://aevon.ca/training-matrix-template.html): free Excel training matrix with expiry colours, and an in-browser checker for a filled-in file
- [BC Skilled Trades Certification checker](https://aevon.ca/skilled-trades-certification-checker.html): free checker for BC contractors; upload a crew list to find workers not registered in a compulsory trade and crews over the 2:1 apprentice ratio
- [COR certification tracking](https://aevon.ca/cor-certification-tracking.html): BC construction COR facts and a free readiness checklist for training and certification records
- [Software to maintain COR certification](https://aevon.ca/cor-maintenance-software.html): what the records side of COR maintenance needs, plus a free certification expiry calculator
- [BambooHR certification tracking](https://aevon.ca/bamboohr-certification-tracking.html): Cadre reads the BambooHR staff list (new hires, changes, leavers) and adds certification tracking on top
- [ADP certification tracking](https://aevon.ca/adp-certification-tracking.html): Cadre keeps its staff list in sync with ADP and adds certification tracking on top. The ADP sync is in pilot and has not been tested against a live ADP account.
- [Construction training matrix builder](https://aevon.ca/construction-training-matrix.html): free in-browser builder; add workers and tickets, colour-coded expiry dates, CSV export and print, no signup
- [Live demo](https://cadre-demo.web.app/dashboard): the real product with a sample company loaded, no signup
- [Aevon Health](https://aevon.ca/health.html): admin automation for medical clinics in BC and Ontario that connects to the clinic's EMR through its official API (OSCAR, with Accuro and TELUS CHR on request). A doctor assigns a follow-up task to Aevon in place of the front desk. Aevon texts the patient three open times, books the one they pick, confirms it and closes the task with a note. No reply, no consent on file, or anything clinical or urgent goes back to the front desk. Text and email only, no voice calls. Also books new referrals and fills cancelled appointments from the clinic's own waitlist. Clinics start with 30 days at no charge, with free onboarding.
- [How to fill a cancelled appointment in OSCAR EMR](https://aevon.ca/oscar-emr-fill-cancelled-appointments.html): step by step using OSCAR's Waiting List and make appt, the limits of the manual way, and the cancellation backfill Aevon Health is building
- [How to track referrals with no response in OSCAR EMR](https://aevon.ca/oscar-emr-referral-follow-up.html): using OSCAR's Consultations screen, what each status means, when rows turn red, how to create a follow-up tickler, and the referral chase list Aevon Health is building
- [Privacy](https://aevon.ca/privacy.html)
